answer.evidence: The object is a vertical column of white and pale-blue rounded puffs, about 6 px wide and 26 rows tall (rows 3-28). The width profile alternates 4, 6, 8, 6, 4 and so on, which is a stack of blobs. It has no front-edge line, eave shadow, ellipse lid, roof or contents. The darker pixels (#a2afcb) sit at the bottom of each puff as shading. There is no solid body and no front face, so it is not a pile of floor debris and does not match the debris kind. It is a vertical smoke or steam effect, so it fits none of the three_quarter, front_elevation or top_down_slab categories and is classed as other.

The tile facts are 0 because the piece is smaller than a tile, so I judged density by eye.
